title: Works good, customer service awful.
text:
Works good, customer service awful.. Works good, but only works on certain size windows for the exhaust tube this comes with.
Works for a 300 square foot room. Not that big of a space!
Comes with remote, or dials on the top.

This comes with a plastic insert to put in your window for the tube to exhaust outside..
The insert is for a double hung window,or a vertical window.
But the smallest vertical (sliding window) this is made for would be 24 5/8 inches small, and largest tall window would be 47 1/4 inches.
The smallest height of a vertical window in my house is 57 inches tall.
This will not work for me unfortunately unless Whirlpool makes a larger window guard!

I called Whirlpool at least 5 hours ago, left my phone numbered to be called back as they ask for.
So far, Nobody has called back!
I consider this Not good customer service.
This is not rocket science, put more phones in, and Hire More People.
Customer service to me is where I shop at. If I walk into a store, or use the Internet which is were I mostly shop at now. (Amazon).
I can only give this Whirlpool air cond, and heater 2 stars!

Btw, if I could use this for about 5 hours a day in the summer, This could raise my electric bill at least $200.00 a month or more.
I also have forced air cond, and solar, but as I mentioned this is expensive to use.
Cooling is Btu for one hour is 13,000. Heating is Btu 11,000.. both on high.

product_metadata.title: Whirlpool WHAP13HAW 13,000 BTU Portable Air Conditioner with Remote Control in White, Up to 450 Sq. Ft
features: Portable unit provides cooling, dehumidification, supplemental heating, and fan-only functions up to 300 sq. Ft
Supplemental heat capability provides an additional heat source to your main heat source when outdoor temperatures are above 45°f
Removes up to 3.5 pints of moisture from the air per hour to control humidity
description: Why put a limit on comfort the Whirlpool portable air conditioner with supplemental heating capability allows for flexible placement and maximum comfort year round. Designed for cooling and dehumidifying a room up to 300 square feet, this versatile unit features on-board electronic controls with 3 speeds and a 24-hour timer, plus a handy remote control. In addition to cooling, this versatile unit also offers supplemental heat capability, providing you with an additional heat source to your main heat source when outdoor temperatures are above 45 degrees Fahrenheit. Easy-rolling caster wheels allow you to conveniently move the unit from room to room, providing cool air when and where you need it most. With the included window exhaust kit, it only takes a few minutes to uninstall and reinstall. At Whirlpool, we take comfort and caring to the next level. see qualifier statement

details.Included Components: portable air conditioner, remote control, 1 exhaust hose, window venting kit, manual, warranty
